meta.title: Sandbox release goal
meta.description: One release note, one follow-up, one owner decision, one sandbox effect.

draft.description: Checkpoint the immutable release artifact and sandbox effect identity.

review.description: Consume the single logical follow-up and checkpoint the owner wait.

approve.description: Checkpoint the owner's original-card answer and its chat record reference.

receipt.description: Keep the sandbox vendor's receipt for the approved effect.

deliver.description: POST the approved note to the local fake using its stable Idempotency-Key, then checkpoint the receipt.
